_comment: super-linter's JSCPD check defaulted to a 0% duplication threshold, which fails on any repeated code at all. This project's own established convention (Wash/Zoe/Kaylee/Vera KiCad generator scripts, the head/cargo/middle/rear splice-collar generators) is to deliberately mirror a prior working generator's structure for consistency -- some incidental line-level duplication across similar-but-not-identical generator scripts is expected, not a copy-paste defect. 2% keeps the check meaningful (catches real accidental copy-paste, like the one duplicate this repo already had and fixed in add_structural_features.py) without hard-failing on the project's own intentional pattern-reuse convention.
